target_customer: At founding, fintechs and wealth managers needing an investment API; after the pivot, procurement and supply chain teams in CPG, energy, automotive and aerospace
problem: Fintechs wanted to offer investment products without building brokerage plumbing. Later, procurement teams struggled to turn unstructured sourcing data into decisions.
product_category: Investment API, then AI procurement assistant

founders.name: Gustavo Trigos
founders.background_notes: Quant at BlackRock, later founded Runtime, per YC page.

founders.name: Daniel Osvath
founders.background_notes: Named in a TechCrunch photo caption.

founders.name: Simon Avila
founders.background_notes: Named in a TechCrunch photo caption.

technical_complexity.rationale: Brokerage and custody integrations for an investment API are heavy on regulation and partners; the later LLM procurement assistant was standard applied AI engineering.

defensibility.rationale: API products with partner integrations are copyable and the procurement assistant faced larger incumbents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Procurement incumbents were adding automation in 2021 to 2025; Mentum was ultimately bought by logistics startup Nuvocargo for its AI agent team.

market_need_then: Not evidenced by a dated source for the original investment API in this research. For procurement, 2021 vendors such as Keelvar and Fairmarkit were growing in sourcing automation.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press found; the name is easily confused with Mentum AI of Lithuania and Momentum named companies.

pivots.to: AI assistant for procurement and strategic sourcing
pivots.why: Not stated in sources found; date unknown

outcome_analysis: Mentum began as an investment API, raised a 4.2 million dollar seed led by Gradient Ventures in 2022, then pivoted to AI procurement agents. Nuvocargo acquired it in October 2025 to bring the team into its R&D organization, which reads as a soft landing rather than a scaled outcome. Terms were not disclosed, and the pivot reason and date are not public.
notes: getmentum.com returned HTTP 503 at fetch time, treated as unreachable rather than dead. Seed date 2022-05 comes from VCBacked and may be off; amount from TechCrunch caption and aggregators. CB Insights shows 4.33M over 4 rounds, unverified. PitchBook lists a different Mentum AI in Lithuania acquired by eany.io, which is a separate company. The strong_team_execution tag is weak, only the acquirer's stated interest in the team supports it. Competitor list left empty: the dated competitor search covered the later procurement pivot, not the 2021 investment API.
